% Consistent section style: title, small gap, full-width rule.
\titleformat{\section}
  {\large\bfseries}{}{0pt}{}[\vspace{2pt}\hrule]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{4pt}

% Sub-heading inside a section (grouping label, no rule).
\newcommand{\grp}[1]{\vspace{5pt}{\bfseries #1}\par\vspace{1pt}}

% Job/entry header: "Title | Organisation, Location            Dates"
\newcommand{\job}[4]{% title, org, location(with leading ", " or empty), dates
  \vspace{4pt}{\bfseries #1} | #2#3 \hfill #4\par}

\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=15pt, itemsep=1pt, topsep=2pt, parsep=0pt}

% Let TeX stretch a little harder before it complains about a loose line.
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{2em}
